sources.usage: Frequency ranking only, restricted to Xinhua four-Han-character entries

method: Trim, keep exactly four Han characters, deduplicate, add six commonly used four-character idioms missing from the source. Easy is manually selected for recognizable scenes; normal is easy plus highest THUOCL-frequency matches up to 2000; challenge is every retained Xinhua entry plus supplements. No claim to exhaust all historical idioms.
